title: Normalized bidual comparison under constant-ring realization
statement: Let X be a scheme and B a finite commutative ring. Let F be the canonical exact derived equivalence from fixed-scalar pro-etale module sheaves to modules over the constant commutative ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let a be a normalized intrinsic tensor-Hom presentation [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models], and s its signed representative symmetry [def-sf-integral-verdier-models]. Assume naturality of s in both variables and first-input naturality of the evaluation counits, with exactly the equations in the Lean statement. Fix arbitrary fixed-scalar derived objects W,K and a normalized ambient duality pairing h into W [lem-weil-duality-pairing]. Write δ_h for its evaluation transpose. Fix arbitrary intrinsic derived objects ω,M and isomorphisms w:FW ≅ ω and i:FK ≅ M. Write δ_a,s for the intrinsic evaluation transpose [def-sf-integral-verdier-models], and H for the intrinsic derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then there is an isomorphism c:F(RHom(RHom(K,W),W)) ≅ H(H(M,ω),ω) such that i followed by δ_a,s at M equals F(δ_h at K) followed by c. No constructibility, finite-Tor, dualizing-object, or invertible-biduality hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Use the constructed inverse scalar tensor realization mu and its signed interchange equation. No new existence statement for internal Hom or for biduality is used.

For an arbitrary equivalence F with this tensor comparison, transpose the composite tensor(i inverse,id), mu, realized evaluation, and w to construct d:F Hom(K,W) to Hom(M,omega). Postcomposition with d is a bijection on Hom(F L,-), by the two tensor-Hom adjunctions, full faithfulness, and the tensor isomorphism. Essential surjectivity constructs an inverse to d. This proves d is an isomorphism and its untranspose is the required evaluation equation. Repeat at Hom(K,W), with input isomorphism d, to construct c.

The ambient pairing normalization gives b(K,DK) followed by e(K) equal to the native adjunction counit: apply inverse transposition to its normalization equation. Hence the inverse transpose of delta_h is b(K,DK) inverse followed by that counit. Transport the native adjunction through the identity-component currying isomorphisms. Untranspose the desired equation and cancel the invertible tensor map of d. Naturality hs, the two evaluation identities, mu naturality and its signed interchange equation identify both composites. Inverse transposition is injective. This constructs the comparisons at M directly, so first-input naturality he need not be invoked.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteIntrinsicBidualComparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X (proEtaleConstantRing X B))
    (s : SignedSymmetry X (proEtaleConstantRing X B) a)
    (hs : ∀ (K L K' L' : proEtaleDerivedCategory X B)
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L'),
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (s.swap K' L').hom =
        (s.swap K L).hom ≫ a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (he : ∀ (K K' W : proEtaleDerivedCategory X B) (f : K' ⟶ K),
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K')
        ((IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X (proEtaleConstantRing X B)).map
          (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 W)))) ≫ (a.adjunction K').counit.app W =
        a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫ (a.adjunction K).counit.app W)
    (W K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B))))
    (h : ProEtale.AmbientDualityPairing
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) X W)
    (ω M : proEtaleDerivedCategory X B)
    (w : (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X B).functor.obj W ≅ ω)
    (i : (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X B).functor.obj K ≅ M) :
    ∃ c : (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X B).functor.obj
        ((dualityDoubleFunctor MonoidalClosed.internalHom W).obj K) ≅
          (IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X (proEtaleConstantRing X B)).obj
            (op ((IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X (proEtaleConstantRing X B)).obj (op M, ω)), ω),
      i.hom ≫ delta X a s ω M =
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X B).functor.map
          (ProEtale.AmbientDualityPairing.bidualityMap
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) X h K) ≫ c.hom
